//: Total GDP, PPP, for pool countries the World Bank has no NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.CD figure for in 2013–2023 (D-108). Read by build-gdp.mjs --only-total; a country the World Bank covers never comes from here. Only the per-continent quintile is used, so a different base year moves nothing that matters.

CU.source: CIA World Factbook, Real GDP (purchasing power parity), 2023 est.
CU.reason: No World Bank PPP series for Cuba. Factbook figure is in 2015 dollars, not current international $.

ER.reason: No World Bank figure in 2013–2023; IMF's last year for Eritrea is 2019.

KP.source: CIA World Factbook, Real GDP (purchasing power parity), 2023 est.
KP.reason: No World Bank or IMF series for North Korea. Factbook figure is in 2015 dollars.

LI.reason: No World Bank PPP series for Liechtenstein.

MC.source: CIA World Factbook, Real GDP (purchasing power parity), 2023 est.
MC.reason: No World Bank or IMF PPP series for Monaco. Factbook figure is in 2015 dollars.

TW.reason: The World Bank does not report Taiwan.

VE.reason: No World Bank figure for Venezuela in 2013–2023.
